step1_analysis.description: A differential difference amplifier (DDA) configured for common-mode feedback. It senses the common-mode voltage of the differential inputs (VOUT_PLUS, VOUT_MINUS), compares it to a reference (VCM), and generates a feedback voltage (CMFB) across a diode-connected load to adjust the main amplifier's bias. A dummy branch (N5) ensures perfect symmetry.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipation of the CMFB amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming B1 biases the PMOS tail current sources (XMM7, XMM8) to ~20uA each. Total current = 40uA. Power = 1.8V * 40uA = 72uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 32.4mW is for the entire magnetic-to-digital converter system. This single CMFB sub-block will consume a small fraction of that, determined by the tail currents.

cm_gain.description: Common-mode gain (A_CM) from the inputs to the CMFB output.

sky130_expected.calculation: A_CM = 2 * gm_p / gm_n. With I_tail = 20uA, gm_p (PMOS input) ~= 100uS. The diode-connected NMOS load carries 20uA, gm_n ~= 328uS. A_CM = 200/328 = 0.61 V/V = -4.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Because the load is diode-connected, the voltage gain is inherently low (around 1 V/V or 0 dB). The main amplifier provides the rest of the CMFB loop gain.

dm_gain.description: Differential-mode gain (A_DM) from the inputs to the CMFB output. Should ideally be zero.

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to the perfectly symmetric DDA topology and dummy branch (N5), differential signals cancel out at the CMFB node.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In a schematic-level simulation without mismatch, the differential gain will be extremely small, limited only by numerical precision and slight channel-length modulation asymmetries.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = gm_load / (2 * pi * C_out). gm_load ~= 328uS. C_out is parasitic capacitance at CMFB node (~20fF). f_3dB = 328uS / (2*pi*20fF) ~= 2.6 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The low-impedance diode-connected load pushes the dominant pole to a very high frequency, making this a wideband CMFB stage.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, common-mode gain, differential-mode gain, and bandwidth of the CMFB amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMFB Amplifier Testbench

.param W_xmm5=5u L_xmm5=0.5u
.param W_xmm2=5u L_xmm2=0.5u
.param W_xmm7=5u L_xmm7=0.5u
.param W_xmm6=5u L_xmm6=0.5u
.param W_xmm8=5u L_xmm8=0.5u
.param W_xmm3=5u L_xmm3=0.5u
.param W_xmm4=5u L_xmm4=0.5u
.param W_xmm1=5u L_xmm1=0.5u

* DUT
XMM5 CMFB CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmm5} w={W_xmm5}
XMM2 CMFB VCM N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmm2} w={W_xmm2}
XMM7 N3 B1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmm7} w={W_xmm7}
XMM6 N5 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmm6} w={W_xmm6}
XMM8 N1 B1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmm8} w={W_xmm8}
XMM3 CMFB VCM N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmm3} w={W_xmm3}
XMM4 N5 VOUT_MINUS N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmm4} w={W_xmm4}
XMM1 N5 VOUT_PLUS N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmm1} w={W_xmm1}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VB1 B1 0 1.1
VVCM VCM 0 0.9

* Input Signal Sources
VCM_IN VCM_IN 0 dc 0.9 ac 1
VDM_IN VDM_IN 0 dc 0 ac 0

* VCVS to generate VOUT_PLUS and VOUT_MINUS
E1 VOUT_PLUS VCM_IN VDM_IN 0 0.5
E2 VOUT_MINUS VCM_IN VDM_IN 0 -0.5

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
  print power
  print v(CMFB)

  * 2. Common-Mode AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let cm_gain_db = vdb(CMFB)
  meas ac cm_gain_dc find cm_gain_db at=10
  meas ac cm_bw when cm_gain_db='cm_gain_dc - 3' fall=1

  * 3. Differential-Mode AC Analysis
  alter VCM_IN ac=0
  alter VDM_IN ac=1
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let dm_gain_db = vdb(CMFB)
  meas ac dm_gain_dc find dm_gain_db at=10

  * 4. DC Sweep for Common-Mode Range
  dc VCM_IN 0 1.8 0.01
  let d_cmfb = deriv(v(CMFB))
  meas dc max_cm_gain max d_cmfb
  
  quit
.endc
.end
